scope.evidenceType: Production engine and pure observation checks executed in Node, with Canvas/environment substitutes; not screenshots, browser input, or live-public evidence.
scope.inputBoundary: Normal DreamGame start/setInput/jump/toggleSoul/recall/pause/resume/setReducedMotion/restart/useItem methods. Offline item API use does not prove inventory UI redemption.
limitations: This report is not final candidate/public CI approval.
Call counts include repeated frames and paused update calls; they are not independent test-case counts.
Five negative geometry contexts are pure-function fixtures and never enter a game runtime.
Full rendered Canvas pixel equivalence was not established by these probes.

source.hashTiming: Hashes were collected after the reported probes. Execution-time hashes were not retained for every earlier probe; these identify the currently reviewed files and do not claim an immutable snapshot of the pre-fix defect.
source.workingChanges: v25 presentation work is uncommitted at this observation boundary; later edits require final integration verification.

pairedRealInputRoute.execution: Inline node --input-type=module heredoc; production DreamGame and unmodified BaseGame advance side by side with identical API calls and 1/60 second update steps.
route: Original chapterIndex 2 spawn; walk toward x490 and stop.
Ordinary jump and direction input reach left shelf near x710/y465.
Wait for absent stage, then the actual outward left dock; walk aboard until body.platform is stage.
Release direction input and verify platform carrying preserves relative body offset.
Perform 12 normal E-equivalent toggleSoul reversals while riding, with varying 2/5/9/20/33/7-frame intervals.
Recall if needed; pause and issue 120 update calls; verify the full performance view and character presentation freeze.
Resume, wait for the real outward stage x970..1000 window, walk off and brake on the actual right shelf.
pairedRealInputRoute.armSegmentContract: Both solved arm segments retain length 20 in every observed presentation.

featherRecoveryDefect.cause: A feather respawn consumes its charge without increasing deaths. Checking only deaths/run/form allowed checkpoint recovery to masquerade as a grounded landing.
featherRecoveryDefect.preFixRoute: Original third-chapter spawn, optional normal useItem(feather_charm), then only right direction input until falling into the first gap; no coordinate assignment.
featherRecoveryDefect.correction: The pre-update sample retains body identity, and the landing record retains its body/run/death identity. Base respawn replaces the body even when a feather prevents a death increment.

landingLifecycle.route: Normal vertical jumps from the original third-chapter spawn.

outOfScopeIsolation.assertions: Performance view remains null and complete getCharacterPresentation output equals the inherited BaseGame presentation after each action.

movingStageEligibility.realInputPositiveCase: The paired route observes actual stage attachment, real overlap, feet at the moving top and idle carrying without walking velocity.
pureNegativeObservationContexts: Feet one unit above the stage
Matching mover id but non-stage kind
movingStageEligibility.assertions: Every negative context has ride=0 and platformId=null.
